protocol.purpose: Strict per-actor-observation decentralized one-step greedy comparison
constraints: SUT receives only obs[:,0]; each UAV receives only its own post-budget observation and action mask.
No extra messages, no online critic/global state/environment access.
Offline calibration labels may use current global training state, like a centralized critic; no evaluation seeds used for fitting.
Local greedy surrogate replaces unobservable global maximum AoI by local maximum divided by number of UAVs; true evaluation reward unchanged.

New decentralized algorithm has independent UAV mode choices (81 or 12288 nominal resource/mode combinations), not the original nine common-mode candidates; score change does not isolate information alone.
Resource candidate scoring is fitted immediate-reward regression, not a new RL run or an exact global optimum.
No hyperparameter or variant selection based on evaluation results.

modes_3.note: Against all-current-state best of three resources, with the same local UAV rule; not test-set tuning.

modes_16.note: Against all-current-state best of three resources, with the same local UAV rule; not test-set tuning.

random_example_selection.algorithm: Python random.Random with OS entropy; one draw each; no redraw
random_example_selection.sampling: Uniform one selected training seed and one evaluation seed, shared across AoI and quality episodes

three_vs_sixteen.fitted_sut: all 13 scenario traces, modes, resource allocations and AoI exactly equal
three_vs_sixteen.calibrated_sut: all 13 scenario traces, modes, resource allocations and AoI exactly equal
